race.comment: ARRESTEDEVELOPMENT (8) is the pick due to a solid three-run profile and suitable class. He finished fifth at Belmont last time, just over four lengths back after losing position but charging late. His Northam second to Squad Goal also stands out for a maiden of this caliber. He looks primed to convert. MR FRODO (1) also ran in the Swing Dancer race, finishing fourth while struggling for room in the straight. The inside draw boosts his chances. MONEY MANZIEL (10) has been competitive in three starts, led but tired over 2013m last time. Back in trip can see him run a better race. DANCING SPIRIT (7) can feature in the finish getting out in distance now.
